neighbours.label: the final ' and' that closes a list of three or more parallel items ('reduce, reuse, recycle, and ...'); 'and' joining just two items or two clauses stays low
fire: The coach told us to stretch, run, jump, and rest between drills.
Good stories answer when, where, why, and how something happened.
The recipe calls for flour, sugar, eggs, and a pinch of salt.
Volunteers will plant, water, weed, and harvest the garden.
The museum covers art, science, history, and music.
Remember to stop, look, listen, and then cross the street.
We visited Paris, Rome, Vienna, and Prague on the trip.
The robot can sort, stack, scan, and pack the boxes.
quiet: The coach told us to stretch and then run between drills.
Good stories explain why something happened and who was there.
The recipe calls for flour and a pinch of salt.
Volunteers will plant the seeds and water the garden.
The museum covers art and is open late on Fridays.
Remember to look both ways and then cross the street.
We visited Paris in spring and loved the trip.
The robot can sort the boxes and then pack them.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.75 on the last ' and' of a 3+ item list; 'and' between two words or clauses below 0.06
notes: Probe: 'who, what, where, and' 0.756, 'reduce, reuse, recycle, and' 0.560, 'apples, pears, plums, and' 0.187, 'Lions, tigers, and' 0.173; two-clause 'and' 0.011, 'tired and hungry' 0.017, 'Bread and butter' 0.048. Short parallel items (wh-words, verbs) score highest.
